changelog: Fixes the early boot splash (fbi) getting evicted from the screen after about a second - it was targeting VT1, which getty@tty1.service also claims for the login prompt a few seconds into boot; the kernel signals the previous VT holder to release it when that happens, which fbi correctly reported as "Oops: terminated" (a graceful signal handler, not a crash) before the console reverted to plain boot text for the rest of boot. Now targets VT2, which no default Raspberry Pi OS getty uses, so nothing contests it. Requires an actual firmware update (not just deploy_manual_files.sh) to reach a device, since early-splash.sh lives in the OTA-managed tree.
